title: RABBIT-SpA: Disease Register for Axial Spondyloarthritis and Psoriatic Arthritis
summary:
Background: Spondyloarthritides are chronic inflammatory diseases that can affect various joints and the spine. Various treatment options are available, and their long-term effectiveness and safety are being studied in routine clinical practice.

Research Question: The study examines how the disease and treatment evolve over time and how effective and safe the medications used are.

Methodology: Over a 10-year observation period, the register collects data on patients with spondyloarthropathies from routine medical care. Among other things, information on the disease, treatment, symptoms, and possible side effects is documented.

interventions.name: RABBIT-SpA is an independent, academically led, longitudinal cohort study of patients with spondyloarthritides (SpA) in routine rheumatology care. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Informed consent
- Diagnosis of axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) or psoriatic arthritis (PsA)
- Initiation of a new treatment with a b/tsDMARD approved for the diagnosis. (Initial prescription | Switch | New prescription of the same substance after a break of at least 3 months)
or
- Initiation of standard systemic therapy following failure of at least one previous standard systemic therapy (standard therapies include: NSAIDs, csDMARDs)
- Clinically relevant dose increase of ongoing NSAID therapy
Exclusion criteria:
Patients without a diagnosis of axial spondyloarthritis or psoriatic arthritis
